scope_rules: Every capability mapping is inherited verbatim from registry/PROBLEM_CAPABILITIES.json (schema 0.1, frozen G1 discovery index); no capability is invented or re-assigned here.
NATIVE_PROBE_PASS_SCOPED requires verify_verdict PASS on the deployed bundle's own pos/neg/err fixtures plus a retained probe receipt with matching sha256.
PORTABLE_LANE_PASS_SCOPED cites merged portable-lane verify receipts for tools the r0 image predates (nuxmv, prob); their deployed-container state is recorded honestly as UNAVAILABLE.
Version drift rows are recorded observations about the r0 bundle; they do not upgrade or downgrade any portfolio lifecycle gate by themselves.
Unverified capability dimensions remain NOT_VERIFIED; probe ineffectiveness never masquerades as version identity.
